
## Expanding Our Community: New Ways We’re Connecting

Building a community around the things we love—like art and data—is all about staying connected. Recently, I have been rethinking how to share updates so that everyone stays informed without feeling overwhelmed by the same messages.

Here is a look at the new approach for our social media and community pages.

### Reaching More People, More Often
In the past, I have relied heavily on a single LinkedIn page. While it is incredible to have 22,000 followers there, a single page has its limits. If I post too often, older updates get buried before people have a chance to see them. 

To fix this, I am expanding our reach across a group of related community pages and platforms like Blue Sky. By spreading our updates across different channels, I can share news more frequently and ensure that every announcement gets the "breathing room" it deserves.

### Keeping Things Fresh with AI Art
We often have important messages that need to be repeated, such as deadlines for Call for Papers (CFP), sponsorship opportunities, or early bird ticket alerts. To keep these reminders from feeling repetitive, I am using **Copilot** to create a wide variety of illustrations.

By changing the visual style each time—moving from minimalist designs to bold, colorful graphics—the message stays the same, but the delivery feels new. This variety helps catch the eye and keeps our feeds looking energetic and diverse.

### Planning for Reliability
Technology isn’t always perfect. You might have noticed that some platforms, like Blue Sky, occasionally run into technical hiccups. This is exactly why a multi-channel strategy is so important. By not putting all our eggs in one basket, the community can stay informed even if one site goes down.

### What’s Next?
The goal is to make our community pages a place where you can always find something interesting to look at and useful to read. By combining smart scheduling with creative AI visuals, I am working to make sure our updates are as vibrant as the community itself.

Thank you for being part of this journey!
